titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Ring, the Birth and the Question of the Father (ch. 31–32)
part: ch. 31–32 — The Ring, the Birth and the Question of the Father
about: Solomon draws the Queen aside and gives her a ring as a token for any son, tells her of his dream, and sends her off with a blessing. She reaches her land, bears a son, returns to her city in state, and rules wisely. The boy, named Bäyna-Ləḥkəm, grows to look like Solomon and, at twelve, asks who his father is; she tries to put him off, but at twenty-two, trained in war and riding, he asks leave to go and see his father.

sentences.t: ፴፩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘወሀባ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ለንግሥት ።
sentences.l: 31. Concerning that-which he-gave sign to-queen.
sentences.i: Chapter 31: Concerning the Sign He Gave to the Queen
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፴፩ is 31 (spoken ሠላሳ ወአሐዱ, śälasa wä-ʾaḥadu). በእንተ 'concerning' governs the relative clause ዘወሀባ 'that which he gave her' (ዘ- relative + ወሀበ 'give', perfect 3rd masculine singular, + -ባ 'her'); ትእምርተ 'a sign' is the object, in the accusative; ለንግሥት 'to the queen' (ለ- marks the recipient).

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሐት ፡ ወወፅአት ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ወአስተፋነዋ ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ግርማ ።
sentences.l: And-she-rejoiced and-she-went-out that she-go, and-he-sent-her-off with-much majesty.
sentences.i: She rejoiced and went out to depart, and he sent her off with great majesty.
sentences.n: ተፈሥሐት 'she rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ); ወወፅአት 'and she went out' (ወፅአ). ከመ ትሖር 'that she might go' (ከመ + subjunctive 3rd feminine of ሖረ). ወአስተፋነዋ 'and he sent her off' (አስተፋነወ, a causative-reflexive stem of ፈነወ 'send', with -ዋ 'her'; the sense is 'sent her on her way'). በብዙኅ ግርማ 'with much majesty, awe' (ግርማ 'majesty, awe-inspiring bearing'). Here ch. 31 opens just after the departure at the end of ch. 30.

sentences.t: ወአግሐሣ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ ፡ ወአውፅአ ፡ ሕልቀተ ፡ እምአጽባዕቱ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትንእስ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ለንግሥት ፡ ወይበላ ፡ ንሥኢ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትርስዕኒ ፡ ወለእመቦ ፡ ዘረከብኩ ፡ እምውስቴትኪ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይኩኖ ፡ ትእምርተ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-took-her-aside, she alone by-themselves, and-he-brought-out ring from-his-fingers which small, and-he-gave to-queen, and-he-said-to-her: Take, that not you-forget-me, and-if-there-is what I-found from-within-you seed, this let-it-be-to-him sign;
sentences.i: He drew her aside, the two of them alone, and took a ring from his fingers, a small one, and gave it to the Queen, and said to her: "Take it, that you may not forget me; and if there is any seed that I have found in you, let this be a sign for him;
sentences.n: አግሐሣ 'he drew her aside' (አግሐሠ, causative of a root meaning 'withdraw, go apart' (?)); እንተ ባሕቲቶሙ 'she by themselves, alone' (ባሕቲት 'solitude' + -ሙ 'their'), meaning privately (?). ወአውፅአ 'and he brought out' (አውፅአ, causative of ወፅአ). ሕልቀት 'ring'; እምአጽባዕቱ 'from his fingers' (እም- 'from'; ጽባዕ 'finger' plural አጽባዕት). እንተ ትንእስ 'which is small' is feminine, so it agrees with the ring (a small ring) as well as with the finger, and I take the ring (?). ንሥኢ 'take!' (feminine imperative of ነሥአ). ከመ ኢትርስዕኒ 'that you not forget me' (ረስዐ 'forget', 2nd feminine, + -ኒ). ወለእመቦ 'and if there is' (ለእመ + ቦ 'there is'). ዘረከብኩ እምውስቴትኪ ዘርአ: ዘ- 'that which' + ረከብኩ 'I found' (1st singular perfect of ረከበ), 'from within you'; ዘርአ 'seed, offspring'. The sense, 'any seed I have found (left) in you', is slightly uncertain in its relative construction (?). ይኩኖ 'let it be to him' (ይኩን jussive + -ኖ 'to him', the child): the ring is to be the child's token of recognition.

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ይምጻእ ፡ ኀቤየ ፤
sentences.l: and-if it-is male, let-him-come to-me;
sentences.i: and if it is a boy, let him come to me;
sentences.n: ወለእመ 'and if'; ኮነ ተባዕተ 'it is male' (ኮነ 'be, become'; ተባዕት 'male', accusative); ይምጻእ 'let him come' (jussive of መጽአ); ኀቤየ 'to me' (ኀበ 'to, beside' + -የ).

sentences.t: ወሰላመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ የሀሉ ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ እነውም ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ራእየ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ በሕልም ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠሪቃ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ተመሥጠት ፡ ወሰረረት ፡ ወአብርሀት ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: and-peace-of God let-be with-you; and-while I-was-sleeping with-you I-saw vision much in-dream: that having-risen sun in-midst-of Israel it-was-snatched-away and-it-moved-on(?) and-it-shone on-land-of Ethiopia;
sentences.i: And may the peace of God be with you. While I slept beside you I saw a great vision in a dream: a sun that had risen in the midst of Israel was snatched away, and passed on (?), and shone upon the land of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: ወሰላመ እግዚኣብሔር የሀሉ ምስሌኪ: ሰላመ 'peace' (accusative, as object of a wish), 'peace of God' (construct); የሀሉ 'let there be' (jussive of ሀሎ 'be'); ምስሌኪ 'with you' (feminine). ወእንዘ እነውም 'and while I was sleeping' (እንዘ + imperfect, circumstantial; ነውመ 'sleep'). ርኢኩ ራእየ 'I saw a vision' (ርእየ, 1st singular perfect). This is the dream of ch. 30 seen from the sleeper's side: Solomon told it there as a sun leaving Israel. ሠሪቃ ፀሐይ 'the sun having risen' (ሠረቀ 'rise', of the sun; the participle phrase is feminine, as ፀሐይ takes feminine verbs). ተመሥጠት 'it was snatched away' (ተመሥጠ, passive of መሠጠ 'snatch'). ሰረረት 'it moved on, passed across' is a guess at an obscure verb (?). አብርሀት 'it shone, gave light' (አብርሀ, causative of በርሀ); ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'upon the land of Ethiopia'.

sentences.t: እንዳዒ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ብኪ ፡ ትትባረክ ፡ ሀግርኪ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ያአምር ።
sentences.l: Enda'i (?) if in-you she-will-be-blessed your-land, God knows.
sentences.i: Whether (?) your land will be blessed through you, God knows.
sentences.n: እንዳዒ is unclear to me and I do not translate it with confidence; from the context I read it as a particle of doubt, 'whether, perhaps' (?). ለእመ ብኪ 'if/whether in you, through you'. ትትባረክ 'she will be blessed' (ተባረከ, reflexive-passive of ባረከ 'bless', 3rd feminine; ሀግርኪ 'your city, land' is feminine and the subject). እግዚኣብሔር ያአምር 'God knows' (አእመረ 'know'). The sentence says that whether the dream will be fulfilled through her is for God alone to know.

sentences.t: ወአንቲሰ ፡ ዕቀቢ ፡ ዘነገርኩኪ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታምልኪዮ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብኪ ፡ ወትግበሪ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-indeed, keep what I-told-you: that you-serve-him God with-all your-heart, and-do his-will;
sentences.i: As for you, keep what I have told you: serve God with all your heart, and do his will;
sentences.n: ወአንቲሰ 'and as for you' (አንቲ + ሰ 'indeed, as for', marking a turn); ዕቀቢ 'keep!' (feminine imperative of ዐቀበ); ዘነገርኩኪ 'what I told you' (ነገረ 'tell'). ከመ ታምልኪዮ 'that you serve him' (አምለከ 'worship, serve', subjunctive 2nd feminine, + -ዮ 'him'), with ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God' repeating the object. በኵሉ ልብኪ 'with all your heart' echoes Deuteronomy 6:5. ወትግበሪ 'and do' (subjunctive 2nd feminine of ገብረ); ፈቃዶ 'his will'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይቀሥፎሙ ፡ ለዕቡያን ፡ ወይሣሀሎሙ ፡ ለትሑታን ፡ ወይነሥት ፡ መናብርቲሆሙ ፡ ለኀያላን ፡ ወያከብሮሙ ፡ ለነዳያን ፤
sentences.l: for he scourges-them the-proud and-has-mercy-on-them the-humble, and-he-tears-down thrones-their of-the-mighty and-he-honors-them the-poor;
sentences.i: for he scourges the proud and has mercy on the humble, he pulls down the thrones of the mighty and honors the poor;
sentences.n: ይቀሥፎሙ 'he scourges them' (ቀሠፈ 'strike, scourge' + -ሙ); ለዕቡያን 'the proud' (ለ- marks the object after the pronoun); ይሣሀሎሙ 'he has mercy on them' (ሣሀለ); ለትሑታን 'the humble'. ይነሥት 'he pulls down' (ነሥተ, taken as 'tear down, overthrow'); መናብርቲሆሙ ለኀያላን 'their thrones, of the mighty' (መንበር 'throne', plural መናብርት). ያከብሮሙ 'he honors them' (አከበረ, causative of ከበረ); ለነዳያን 'the poor'. The reversal of the proud and humble recalls Luke 1:52 and 1 Samuel 2:7–8.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወሕይወት ፡ እምኀበሁ ፡ ወብዕል ፡ ወንዴት ፡ በፈቃዱ ፡ ይትወሀብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየአቢዮ ፡ ለትእዛዙ ፡ ወለኰነኔሁ ፡ በሰማይ ፡ ወበምድር ፡ በባሕር ፡ ወበቀላያት ፤
sentences.l: for death and-life from-him, and-wealth and-poverty by-his-will are-given, for all to-him, and-there-is-not who refuses his-command and-his-judgment, in-heaven and-on-earth, in-sea and-in-the-deeps;
sentences.i: for death and life come from him, wealth and poverty are given at his will, for all is his, and there is none who refuses his command and his judgment, in heaven and on earth, in the sea and in the deeps;
sentences.n: እምኀበሁ 'from beside him, from him'. ብዕል 'wealth' and ንዴት 'poverty'. በፈቃዱ ይትወሀብ 'are given by his will' (ይትወሀብ, passive of ወሀበ; the singular verb takes the pair as one). ኵሉ ሎቱ 'all is his'. ወአልቦ ዘየአቢዮ 'and there is none who refuses it' (አበየ 'refuse, resist' + -ዮ 'it'); ትእዛዙ 'his command' and ኰነኔሁ 'his judgment', each with ለ- marking the object. ቀላያት 'the deeps, the waters' (plural of ቀላይ). The word-for-word sense is clear; the list of four realms is the usual Ethiopic doxology.

sentences.t: ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ የሀሉ ፡ ምስሌኪ ፡ ወሖሪ ፡ በሰላም ።
sentences.l: and-God let-be with-you and-go in-peace.
sentences.i: And may God be with you; go in peace.
sentences.n: የሀሉ 'let him be' (jussive of ሀሎ); ሖሪ 'go!' (feminine imperative of ሖረ); በሰላም 'in peace' (በ- 'in').

sentences.t: ወተፋነው ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-took-leave-of-one-another (?). ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And they took leave of one another (?).
sentences.n: ተፋነው: ተፋነወ is the reciprocal stem of ፈነወ 'send', 'take leave of each other, part'; the printed ወተፋነው has the plural ending -ው (as in ተፋነዉ), so 'they parted' (?); the form could also be a singular with a plural spelling, and I follow the plural. The run of six ፨ closes the chapter and is kept as printed in the source.

sentences.t: ፴፪ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ወለደት ፡ ወበጽሐት ፡ ብሔራ ።
sentences.l: 32. How she-bore and-she-arrived her-land.
sentences.i: Chapter 32: How She Gave Birth and Reached Her Land
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፴፪ is 32 (spoken ሠላሳ ወክልኤቱ, śälasa wä-kəlʾetu). ዘከመ 'how, that' (ዘ- + ከመ); ወለደት 'she bore' (ወለደ, perfect 3rd feminine); ወበጽሐት 'and she arrived' (በጽሐ); ብሔራ 'her land' (accusative, -ራ 'her').

sentences.t: ወሖረት ፡ ወበጽሐት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ባላ ፡ ዘዲሳርያ ፡ በ፱ ፡ አውራኅ ፡ ወበ፭ ፡ ዕለታት ፡ እምዘ ፡ ተፈነወት ፡ በኀቤሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-went and-she-arrived to city-of Bala which-of Disarya, in-9 months and-in-5 days from-when she-was-sent from-him;
sentences.i: She went and reached the city of Bala in Disarya, in nine months and five days from the time she was sent away from him;
sentences.n: ሀገረ ባላ ዘዲሳርያ 'the city of Bala which is of Disarya': both are place names I cannot place; ዲሳርያ may be a form of Caesarea (?). ሀገረ is in the construct, accusative. በ፱ አውራኅ: በ፱ is 'in nine', spoken በትስዐቱ (bä-təsʿätu); አውራኅ 'months' (plural of ወርኅ). ወበ፭ ዕለታት 'and in five days': ፭ is 5, spoken በኀምስቱ (bä-ḫaməstu); ዕለታት 'days'. The spoken forms are my reconstruction (?), as in ch. 30. እምዘ ተፈነወት 'from when she was sent' (ተፈነወ, passive of ፈነወ); በኀቤሁ 'from beside him'. Nine months and five days is the time from her leaving to the birth.

sentences.t: ወአኀዛ ፡ ማሕምም ፡ ወወለደት ፡ ሕፃነ ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ወወሀበቶ ፡ ለሐፃኒት ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ክብር ፡ ወተድላ ፤
sentences.l: and-seized-her pains(?) and-she-bore child male and-she-gave-him to-the-nurses with-much honor and-delight;
sentences.i: The pangs (?) took hold of her, and she bore a male child and gave him to the nurses with great honor and delight;
sentences.n: ወአኀዛ 'and it seized her' (አኀዘ 'seize, take hold of' + -ዛ 'her'). ማሕምም I read as 'pangs, suffering' from a root meaning 'be ill' (?); it is the subject and is not clearly attested to me. ሕፃነ ተባዕተ 'a male child' (accusatives). ወወሀበቶ 'and she gave him' (ወሀበ + -ቶ 'him'); ለሐፃኒት 'to the nurses' (feminine plural). በብዙኅ ክብር ወተድላ 'with much honor and delight'.

sentences.t: ወይእቲሰ ፡ ነበረት ፡ እስከ ፡ ይትፌጸም ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ንጽሓ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ አተወት ፡ ሀገራ ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ግርማ ።
sentences.l: And-she indeed remained until might-be-fulfilled days-of her-purification, and-then she-returned her-city with-much majesty.
sentences.i: She remained there until the days of her purification were fulfilled, and then she returned to her city in great majesty.
sentences.n: ወይእቲሰ 'and she indeed' (ይእቲ 'she' + ሰ). እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until it be fulfilled' (ተፈጸመ, passive of ፈጸመ 'complete'); መዋዕለ ንጽሓ 'the days of her purity' (መዋዕል 'days', plural, in the construct; ንጽሕ 'purity'). I take it as the days of purification after childbirth (compare Leviticus 12) (?). አተወት 'she returned' (አተወ 'come back'); ሀገራ 'her city, her country'.

sentences.t: አብኡ ፡ መኳንንቲሃ ፡ አምኃ ፡ ለእግዝእቶሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ነበሩ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወሰገዱ ፡ ወገነዩ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፡ በእትወታ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አድያም ፤
sentences.l: Brought her-nobles gift to-their-lady who were there, and-they-bowed and-they-did-homage to-her, and-rejoiced at-her-return all the-regions;
sentences.i: Her nobles who were there brought gifts to their lady, bowed down and did her homage, and all the regions rejoiced at her return;
sentences.n: አብኡ 'they brought' (አብአ, here 'offer'); መኳንንቲሃ 'her nobles' (መኰንን, plural መኳንንት, + -ሃ 'her'); አምኃ 'gift, tribute' (accusative); ለእግዝእቶሙ 'to their lady' (እግዝእት, feminine of እግዚእ 'lord', + -ሙ 'their'). እለ ነበሩ ህየ 'who were there' (እለ plural relative). ሰገዱ 'they bowed down' (ሰገደ); ገነዩ ላቲ 'they did her service, paid homage' (ገነየ, with ላቲ 'to her'). በእትወታ 'at her return' (በ- 'at'; እትወት, verbal noun of አተወ); ኵሉ አድያም 'all the regions, borders' (አድያም, plural of ድማ).

sentences.t: ወአልበስቶሙ ፡ ሥናየ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ለክቡራኒሆሙ ፡ ወቦ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ወሀበት ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ወብሩረ ፡ ወያክንተ ፡ ወሜላተ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ወሀበት ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ።
sentences.l: And-she-clothed-them beautiful garments for-their-honored-ones, and-there-were those to-whom she-gave gold and-silver and-jacinth and-meläs (?), and-all goods she-gave what is-needed.
sentences.i: She clothed them in fine garments, for their honored ones, and to some she gave gold and silver, jacinth and a precious ware (?), and she gave all the goods that were needed.
sentences.n: ወአልበስቶሙ 'and she clothed them' (አልበሰ 'clothe', causative of ለበሰ, + -ሙ 'them'); ሥናየ አልባሰ 'beautiful garments' (accusative; the adjective precedes). ለክቡራኒሆሙ 'for their honored ones' (ክቡር 'honored', plural ክቡራን). ወቦ ለዘ ወሀበት 'and there were those to whom she gave' (ቦ 'there is'). ወርቅ 'gold', ብሩር 'silver'; ያክንት 'jacinth, a blue or violet stone'. ሜላት is unknown to me: a precious thing or cloth (?). ንዋየ 'goods' and ዘይትፈቀድ 'what is needed' (ተፈቀደ, passive of ፈቀደ), as in ch. 30. She is the generous queen of a restored court.

sentences.t: ወአርትዐት ፡ መንግሥታ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-set-right her-kingdom;
sentences.i: She set her kingdom in order;
sentences.n: አርትዐት 'she set right, put in order' (አርትዐ, causative of a root 'be straight', 3rd feminine); መንግሥታ 'her kingdom' (accusative). A short unit, because the text puts a ፤ here.

sentences.t: ወአልቦ ፡ ዘተዐደወ ፡ እምቃላ ፡ እስመ ፡ አፍቀረታ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አጽንዐ ፡ መንግሥታ ፨
sentences.l: and-there-is-not who transgressed from-her-word, for she-loved wisdom, and-God made-firm her-kingdom.
sentences.i: None departed from her word, for she loved wisdom, and God made her kingdom firm.
sentences.n: ዘተዐደወ እምቃላ 'who transgressed from her word' (ተዐደወ 'pass over, transgress'; ቃል 'word', + -ኣ 'her'). አፍቀረታ ለጥበብ 'she loved wisdom' (አፍቀረ 'love', with a pronoun -ታ 'it' repeating the object marked by ለ-). አጽንዐ 'he made firm' (አጽንዐ, causative of ጸንዐ), the subject being God. The unit ends at ፨, a section mark in the middle of the chapter.

sentences.t: ወልህቀ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕፃን ፡ ወሰመየቶ ፡ ስሞ ፡ በይነ ፡ ልሕክም ።
sentences.l: And-he-grew that child, and-she-named his-name Bäyna-Ləḥkəm (?).
sentences.i: The child grew, and she named him Bäyna-Ləḥkəm (?).
sentences.n: ወልህቀ 'and he grew' (ልሕቀ 'grow up'); ሰመየቶ ስሞ 'she named his name' (ሰመየ 'name' + -ቶ 'him', with ስሞ 'his name' as the second accusative). በይነ ልሕክም: I read it as an Arabic-derived 'son of the wise man' (ibn al-ḥakīm), a name taken by tradition for the son who becomes Menelik; I leave it in Geʿez form and flag it (?). The text does not yet say Menelik; that name comes later in the book.

sentences.t: ወጽነ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወየሐትቶሙ ፡ ለመሐዛሁ ፡ ሐፃንያኒሁ ፡ ወይብሎሙ ፡ መኑ ፡ አቡየ ፤
sentences.l: And-lasted for-him 12 years, and-he-questioned-them his-companions(?), his-boys, and-he-said-to-them: Who my-father?
sentences.i: When he was twelve years old (?), he questioned his companions, the boys, and said to them: "Who is my father?"
sentences.n: ወጽነ ሎቱ 'and it lasted for him' (ጽነ, taken from a root 'endure, last' (?)), so 'twelve years passed for him', meaning he reached twelve (?). ፲ወ፪ is 12, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu); ዓመት 'year'; the spoken form is my reconstruction (?). የሐትቶሙ 'he questioned them' (ሐተተ 'inquire' + -ሙ). ለመሐዛሁ: meaning unclear, 'his companions, peers' (?); ሐፃንያኒሁ 'his boys' (ሐፃን 'child'). ይብሎሙ 'and he says to them'. መኑ አቡየ 'who is my father?' (መኑ 'who'; አቡየ 'my father').

sentences.t: ወይብልዎ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: and-they-say-to-him: Solomon king;
sentences.i: and they answered him: "King Solomon";
sentences.n: ይብልዎ 'they say to him' (ይብሉ 'they say' + -ዎ 'him'; the present-tense form in a narrative). ሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'Solomon the king' (no article in Geʿez). The boys know the father from common talk.

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እሙ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ኦንግሥት ፡ አይድዕኒ ፡ መኑ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ በቊጥዓ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትጌርሞ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይፍቅድ ፡ ሐዊረ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-went to his-mother queen and-he-said-to-her: O queen, tell-me, who my-father? and-she-said-to-him, queen, in-anger while she-rebuked-him that not he-wish to-go;
sentences.i: He went to his mother, the Queen, and said to her: "O Queen, tell me, who is my father?" And the Queen said to him in anger, rebuking him so that he would not wish to go:
sentences.n: ኀበ እሙ ንግሥት 'to his mother, the queen' (እም 'mother', + -ሁ, written -ሙ). ወይቤላ 'and he said to her'; ኦንግሥት 'O queen' (ኦ vocative); አይድዕኒ 'tell me!' (imperative of አይድዐ 'make known' + -ኒ). ወትቤሎ 'and she said to him'. በቊጥዓ 'in anger'. እንዘ ትጌርሞ 'while she rebuked, drove him off' (ጌረመ 'rebuke, scold' (?), 3rd feminine + -ሞ, -ሁ 'him'); ከመ ኢይፍቅድ ሐዊረ 'so that he would not wish to go' (ሐዊረ, infinitive of ሖረ).

sentences.t: ለምንት ፡ ትሴአለኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ አብ ፤
sentences.l: Why you-ask-me about father;
sentences.i: "Why do you ask me about a father?
sentences.n: ለምንት 'why'; ትሴአለኒ 'you ask me' (ሰአለ 'ask', 2nd masculine imperfect + -ኒ); በእንተ አብ 'about a father'.

sentences.t: አነ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወእምከ ፡ ወባዕደ ፡ ኢትኅሥሥ ።
sentences.l: I she, your-father and-your-mother, and-other not-seek.
sentences.i: I am your father and your mother; seek no other."
sentences.n: አነ ይእቲ 'I am she' (አነ + ይእቲ, the feminine pronoun, since the speaker is a woman); አቡከ ወእምከ 'your father and your mother'; ባዕደ 'another, a stranger' (accusative); ኢትኅሥሥ 'do not seek' (negative jussive, ኀሠሠ).

sentences.t: ወወፅአ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ወሥልስ ፡ ይሴአላ ፡ ወያጽሕባ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትንግሮ ።
sentences.l: And-he-went-out from-her and-stayed, and-again and-a-third-time he-asked-her and-pressed-her(?) that she-tell-him.
sentences.i: He left her and stayed away, and a second time and a third he asked her and pressed her (?) to tell him.
sentences.n: ወፅአ እምኔሃ 'he went out from her' (እምኔሃ 'from her'); ነበረ 'he stayed'. ወካዕበ ወሥልስ 'and again, and a third' (ካዕበ 'a second time'; ሥልስ 'third'). ይሴአላ 'he asks her'; ወያጽሕባ 'and pressed her' is uncertain as to stem (?); ከመ ትንግሮ 'that she tell him' (ነገረ, subjunctive 3rd feminine + -ሮ, -ሁ 'him').

sentences.t: ወአሐተ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ነገረቶ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፡ ርሑቅ ፡ ብሔሩ ፡ ወዕፁብ ፡ ፍኖቱ ፡ ወኢትፍቅድ ፡ ህየ ።
sentences.l: And-one day she-told-him, while she-says: Far his-land and-hard his-road, and-not-wish there.
sentences.i: At last, one day, she told him: "His land is far, his road is hard; do not wish to go there."
sentences.n: ወአሐተ ዕለተ 'and on one day' (accusative of time). ነገረቶ 'she told him'; እንዘ ትብል 'saying' (lit. 'while she says'). ርሑቅ ብሔሩ 'far is his land' (ርሑቅ 'far'); ዕፁብ ፍኖቱ 'hard is his road' (ዕፁብ 'hard, difficult', also 'wonderful'; ፍኖት 'road'). ኢትፍቅድ ህየ 'do not wish [to go] there'; the verb 'go' is understood.

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ወልድ ፡ በይነ ፡ ልሕክም ፡ ኮነ ፡ ላሕየ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ማኅፈዱ ፡ ወአባሉ ፡ ወንብረተ ፡ ክሳዱ ፡ ይመስል ፡ ስሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወአዕይንቲሁ ፡ ወአቊያጺሁ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ፍኖቱ ፡ ይመስል ፡ ስሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፨
sentences.l: And-he indeed, son Bäyna-Ləḥkəm, was beautiful-of-form, and-all his-stature(?) and-his-build(?) and-the-set-of his-neck resembled Solomon king his-father, and-his-eyes and-his-brows(?), and-all his-way resembled Solomon king.
sentences.i: Now the son, Bäyna-Ləḥkəm, was beautiful of form, and all his stature (?) and build (?) and the set of his neck resembled King Solomon his father, as did his eyes and his brows (?), and all his bearing resembled King Solomon.
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'and as for him'; ወልድ በይነ ልሕክም 'the son Bäyna-Ləḥkəm'; ላሕየ 'beautiful of form' (a noun in the accusative of respect). ማኅፈዱ ('his stature or frame') and አባሉ ('his build') are rare words I cannot confirm (?); ንብረተ ክሳዱ 'the set of his neck' (ንብረት 'sitting, set, posture'; ክሳድ 'neck'). ይመስል 'resembles' (መሰለ, with the likeness as accusative: ስሎሞን ንጉሠ አቡሁ 'Solomon king, his father'); አዕይንቲሁ 'his eyes'; አቊያጺሁ is unknown to me: from its place next to the eyes I read it as 'brows' or 'eyelids' (?). ኵሉ ፍኖቱ 'all his way, his manner'. Bezold spells the king's name ስሎሞን here, ሰሎሞን above. The unit is 44 words, kept whole as it has no ፤; it ends at ፨.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ፳ወ፪ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተምህረ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ፀብአ ፡ ወፈረሰ ፡ ወንዕወ ፡ አራዊት ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘበሕገ ፡ ውርዙት ።
sentences.l: And-when it-was to-him 22 years he-learned all war and-horsemanship and-the-ndʿwä (?) of-beasts and-all what by-the-rule-of wurzut (?).
sentences.i: When he was twenty-two years old he had learned all warfare and riding, and the ንዕወ (?) of wild beasts, and all that belongs to the custom of the ውርዙት (?).
sentences.n: ወሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ 'and when it was to him, when he was' ; ፳ወ፪ is 22, spoken ዕሥራ ወክልኤቱ (ʿəśra wä-kəlʾetu), a reconstruction (?); ዓመተ 'years' (accusative). ተምህረ 'he learned' (ተምህረ, perfect of መሀረ 'teach' in the reflexive-passive sense). ፀብአ 'war'; ፈረሰ 'horsemanship, riding' (from ፈረስ 'horse'). ንዕወ is unknown to me: from its place before አራዊት 'beasts' it may be 'taming' or 'hunting' (?). ዘበሕገ ውርዙት 'what is by the law of ውርዙት'; ሕግ 'law, rule', but ውርዙት I cannot place, perhaps 'throwing, javelin-sport' or 'youth' (?). In the English I leave both uncertain words in Geʿez.

sentences.t: ወይበላ ፡ ለንግሥት ፡ አሐውር ፡ እነጽር ፡ ገጸ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእገብእ ፡ ዝየ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-the-queen: I-will-go, I-will-see face-of my-father, and-I-will-return here, by-the-will-of God, God-of Israel. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: He said to the Queen: "Let me go and see my father's face, and I will return here, by the will of God, the God of Israel."
sentences.n: ወይበላ ለንግሥት 'and he said to her, to the queen' (ይበላ, a variant spelling of ይቤላ; as in ch. 31). አሐውር እነጽር 'I will go, I will look' (1st singular subjunctives of ሖረ and ነጸረ). ገጸ አቡየ 'the face of my father' (ገጽ 'face', construct). እገብእ ዝየ 'I will return here' (ገብአ 'return'). በፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the will of God'; አምላከ እስራኤል 'the God of Israel', in apposition. The run of nine ፨ closes the chapter and is kept as printed.
